1.name: Keating Hall
lines:
KEATING HALL
The gothic building with the big central tower, one of the best-known sights at Rose Hill.

2.name: Dealy Hall
lines:
DEALY HALL
Classrooms and faculty offices.

3.name: University Church
lines:
UNIVERSITY CHURCH
Fordham is a Jesuit university. Everyone is welcome here, whatever your faith.

EDWARDS PARADE
The big lawn at the heart of the Rose Hill campus.

5.name: Orientation Leader
lines: Hey, welcome to Fordham! I'm one of your Orientation Leaders.
This big lawn is Edwards Parade. Keating Hall is the big building with the tower.
Look around and talk to people. Press Z when you're facing someone or a sign.

6.name: Sophomore
lines: First week? Don't stress. Everyone gets lost at least once.
Pro tip: read the signs. They tell you where things are.
THIS WAY: the rest of Rose Hill

8.name: Junior
lines: I love studying out here on the lawn between classes.
When it gets cold, though, you'll find me in the library.
